core_obligations: Reduce to verifying the assumptions of the change-of-rings criterion for O -> B on C_{B/A} (proof lines 937-941).
Choose a resolution P_bullet of B over A and the induced cosimplicial object U_bullet (proof lines 941-943).
Show that Lpi_!O = B via the quasi-isomorphism on associated complexes (proof lines 944-945).
Show that Lpi_!B is computed by B(U_bullet) = B, verifying the second assumption (proof lines 946-949).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: with pi, O and B as fixed by the pi-equation, for any O-module F one has Lpi_!(F) = Lpi_!(Li^*F) = Lpi_!(F tensor_O^L B) in D(Ab) (source lines 925-935). The proof verifies the assumptions of the change-of-rings criterion of Cohomology on Sites for O -> B on the category C_{B/A}: a resolution P_bullet of B over A gives a suitable cosimplicial object U_bullet, the induced map on associated complexes is a quasi-isomorphism so Lpi_!O = B, and on the other hand Lpi_!B is computed by B(U_bullet) = B, which verifies the second assumption and hence gives the statement.
